name: Sylvia Garcia
page_title: Sylvia Garcia's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Democratic for U.S. House (TX) - District 29

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "I call on my Senate colleagues to codify Roe v. Wade immediately."
"One year after Roe v. Wade fell, @HouseDemocrats are still fighting for reproductive freedom. Abortion is health care – period."

"This week, the Supreme Court will hear arguments asking them to overturn #RoeVWade We must protect women’s access to critical reproductive care & stop attacks like TX’s #SB8 & the SCOTUS case. It’s time for the Senate to pass the Women’s Health Protection Act & codify Roe today."

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "On this 87th anniversary of Social Security, I vow to continue to put #PeopleOverPolitics and #ProtectSocialSecurity for our seniors. Sadly, extreme MAGA Republicans want to end this program, but @HouseDemocrats and I won’t let that happen."

"Social Security benefits are the bedrock of retirement income paid into by working Americans their entire lives. We must protect and expand benefits so that every senior is able to retire with dignity and keep up with the rising costs of living."

"Today millionaires and billionaires stop paying into #SocialSecurity for the rest of 2020, while most workers are expected to contribute year round. It's time to change that! #ScraptheCap and use the additional money from millionaires and billionaires to #ExpandSocialSecurity."
Rated 100% by Alliance for Retired Americans

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "@HouseDemocrats and President Biden have already delivered record deficit reduction. Now, we’re working to reduce the deficit even more by making the wealthy and well-connected pay their fair share."

"@HouseDemocrats are putting People Over Politics to lower costs and create better-paying jobs. We’re committed to growing the middle class by investing in America and making sure big corporations and billionaires pay their fair share."

"House Republicans used their very first bill to hand a giveaway to big corporations and billionaires that cheat on their taxes, adding an explosive $114 billion to the deficit. House Democrats will always fight to ensure the well-off pay their fair share."
Rated 13% by FreedomWorks

positions.question: Do you support the regulation of indirect campaign contributions from corporations, unions, and individuals?

evidence.text: "#CitizensUnited opened the floodgate of corporate spending in politics causing a wave of dark money to influence our elections and drown out the voices of every day Americans."
"It’s time that the Senate pass #HR1, which would help eliminate the influence of dark money in our elections."
Rated 94% by Common Cause
Voted in favor of HR 1 "For the People Act of 2021."

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "Marched w/ thousands of Houstonians who are peacefully demanding justice for #GeorgeFloyd and systemic changes. We must put an end to police brutality, racism, and white supremacy. There is no place for any of this in Houston or anywhere in America."
"Today, I stand proudly and boldly with @HouseDemocrats in support of the #GeorgeFloyd #JusticeInPolicingAct, which tackles head on police brutality and racial profiling in policing."
Voted in favor of HR 1280 "George Floyd Justice in Policing Act of 2021."

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "Houstonians deserve affordable housing! @FSCDems is proud of the work done by Secretary Fudge and @HUDgov to improve housing supply, affordability, and equitable access"

"In the past decade, Houston home prices have nearly doubled, and half of residents now spend more than 30% of their income on housing costs alone. It's time to uplift our communities and close the gap in affordable housing."

"The @SenateGOP turned their backs on millions of Americans who could soon face evictions in the middle of a pandemic. The Senate must pass @RepMaxineWaters’ emergency housing bill to create a $100 billion rental assistance fund and extend the eviction moratorium."

"Say it with me: #HousingIsInfrastructure The people of my district know that investing in families and housing is how we #BuildBackBetter. Because every American should be able to say "mi casa es su casa," let’s get it done."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "Democrats passed the Infrastructure Law, the CHIPS and Science Act, and now we’ve passed the Inflation Reduction Act to create better-paying jobs with investments in clean, secure American energy."

"With the Inflation Reduction Act, Democrats are lowering health care premiums for working Americans by hundreds per month – taking on the special interests and putting more $$$ in your pocket. #PeopleOverPolitics"
Voted in favor of H.R. 5376 "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "@POTUS has taken a massive step in the right direction by forgiving up to $20,000 in student loan debt to help everyday working families. Simply put, he put #peopleoverpolitics. I’m proud of our President, and I can’t wait to see the positive impact this has on our country."
"I am deeply dissappointed by the Supreme Court's decision to strike down President Biden's Student Loan Forgiveness Plan."
"Thanks you @POTUS for putting #PeopleOverPolitics with your Student Loan Forgiveness Plan. This will bring much-needed relief to hardworking American families."

"The Biden-Harris Administration’s student debt relief plan will provide 40 million working and middle-class Americans a little extra breathing room as they recover from the pandemic and prepare to resume loan payments."

positions.question: Do you support requiring a government-issued identification in order to vote at the polls?

evidence.text: "I voted to protect the #votingrights of every Texan by voting YES on the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act. Thank you to TX Dems for your brave efforts! #HR4 will ensure that the TX GOP #SuppressionSessions can no longer threaten the voting rights of our communities."
Rated 94% by Common Cause
Voted in favor of H.R. 4 "John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act of 2021"
Voted in favor of H.R. 5746 "Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act"

positions.question: Do you generally support gun-control legislation (e.g. red flag laws, boyfriend loopholes)?

evidence.text: "Malls are not safe, schools are not safe, and places of worship are not safe. We should not be afraid to step outside our homes out of fear of losing our lives at the mercy of an assault weapon. It's time to put people over the NRA, and we need gun reform NOW."

"Today, I #WearOrange for every victim of gun violence because they deserve to be honored with actions that can #EndGunViolence in America. That's why I urge the @senatemajldr to take immediate action on gun reform measures already passed in the House."
Rated 0% by Gun Owners of America
Voted in favor of HR 1446 "Enhanced Background Checks Act of 2021."

positions.question: Do you support a government-run (e.g. single-payer) healthcare program, such as Medicare-for-All?

evidence.text: "Access to healthcare is a fundamental human right and should be universally available for everyone."

"I’ve worked as a County Commissioner to expand local community clinics and as a State Senator appealing to state leaders to expand Medicaid in our State. Now, I’m ready to take that fight to Washington, and I will work tirelessly at the federal level as I did at the state and local level to ensure all Texans have access to quality healthcare. I will fight for Medicare for All."
"Right now, 4 million Texans have no healthcare coverage. This is unacceptable, especially in a pandemic. That’s why I am fighting to expand #Medicaid & help Texans access the coverage they need."

positions.question: Do you support expanding paid family AND/OR medical leave benefits (e.g. maternity leave)?

evidence.text: "Nearly 4 in 5 private sector workers have no access to paid family leave. The #BuildBackBetter Agenda guarantees 12 weeks of paid family and medical leave, to help improve the health of new mothers & reduce wage loss. Let’s get it done!"

"No parent should have to choose between their job and their sick child. For working families, paid leave is essential. That's why I proudly joined a letter with my @HouseDemocrats colleagues in support of the paid leave program in the #BuildBackBetter Act."

"Paid leave is essential for working families. It improves the economy by ensuring workers don’t lose their jobs because they had a child, or their elder parent needs care. Paid leave for American workers is part of how we #BuildBackBetter"
Voted in favor of H.R. 6201 "Families First Coronavirus Response Act"

positions.question: Should the government be able to regulate the cost of prescription drugs?

evidence.text: "@HouseDemocrats have taken on Big Pharma to lower prescription drug prices. Our new law caps insulin prices at $35 a month and limits out-of-pocket costs for seniors on Medicare – saving millions of Americans money."

"Democrats are lowering health care and prescription drug costs for Americans, cutting costs for people who buy health care coverage on their own, capping out-of-pocket drug costs for seniors, and giving Medicare the power to negotiate lower prices."
Voted in favor of H.R. 3 "Lower Drug Costs Now Act of 2019"
Voted in favor of H.R. 6833 "The Affordable Insulin Now Act"

positions.question: Do you support increasing security along the southern US border?

evidence.text: "Appalled by the ongoing cruel and inhumane tactics employed by @GovAbbott at the Texas border. The situation's reality is unsettling as these buoys' true danger and brutality come to light. We must stop this NOW!"

"I support @RepPressley's amendment that would block the President from diverting funds from the North American Development Bank for his #BorderWall vanity project. This bank funds environmental projects on the U.S.-Mexico border. He must not misuse these funds for his wall."

"What’s radical is how @ICEgov hurts #Immigrant and #Latino communities. I urge my colleagues in Congress to work with me to decriminalize border crossings and #AbolishICE. We owe it to families such as Roland’s that are affected by such policies."

evidence.text: "Economists agree: a pathway to citizenship for #Dreamers, TPS holders, and essential workers would grow the economy and create jobs for everyone. But on top of that, it’s simply the right thing to do. Let’s get a pathway to citizenship in reconciliation. #WeAreHome"

"Folks are more outraged with @SpeakerPelosi ripping up the speech in half than with the fact that Trump has ripped families apart at the border. #SOTU2020 He’s ripped babies from their parents’ arms and put them in cages. That should outrage EVERYONE!"
